name: google-secops
description: Essential Security Operations skills for Triage, Investigation, and Hunting.

secops.http_headers_helper: TOKEN=$(gcloud auth application-default print-access-token) || exit 1; if [ -z "$TOKEN" ]; then echo 'google-secops: no ADC token; run: gcloud auth application-default login' >&2; exit 1; fi; PROJECT="${PROJECT_ID:-$(gcloud config get-value project 2>/dev/null)}"; case "$PROJECT" in ''|'(unset)'|*[!a-zA-Z0-9:.-]*) echo 'google-secops: no valid quota project; set PROJECT_ID or run: gcloud config set project PROJECT_ID' >&2; exit 1;; esac; printf '{"Authorization":"Bearer %s","x-goog-user-project":"%s"}' "$TOKEN" "$PROJECT"

interface.shortDescription: Essential Security Operations skills for Triage, Investigation, and Hunting
